positioning.what_company_sells: Built-in kitchen appliances and professional kitchen equipment for distributors, importers and project suppliers.
positioning.main_value_proposition: European-certified quality at 25–35% below Western European factory prices, with 3-week delivery to EU and GCC.
positioning.delivery_capabilities: FOB Istanbul, CIF EU main ports, door delivery GCC

products.name: Built-in oven series (SVN-B)
products.description: 60cm multifunction built-in ovens, A+ energy, 9 programs, telescopic rails.

products.name: Induction cooktop line (SVN-I)
products.description: 4-zone induction cooktops with booster, slider touch control, 7.2kW.

products.name: Range hood collection (SVN-H)
products.description: Wall-mount and telescopic hoods, 650 m³/h, low-noise EC motors.

products.name: Dishwasher series (SVN-D)
products.description: 60cm freestanding and fully-integrated dishwashers, 14 place settings.

products.name: Compact kitchen program (SVN-C)
products.description: Mini-kitchen units for studios, hotels and modular housing projects.

products.name: Professional HoReCa series (SVN-P)
products.description: Heavy-duty convection ovens and ranges for hotels and catering.

product_understanding: Core strength is built-in cooking appliances (ovens, cooktops, hoods) with EU certification and OEM flexibility.
HoReCa series opens a second buyer universe: hotel equipment suppliers and F&B procurement, strongest in GCC.
Compact kitchen program fits hotel/studio construction projects — a differentiator few Turkish exporters offer.
ideal_customer_profile: Importers/distributors of kitchen appliances, 10–200 employees, with dealer networks or project business.
Hotel equipment suppliers serving 4–5★ hospitality projects in GCC.
Retail chains and white goods dealers seeking white-label built-in lines with EU certificates.
market_assumptions: Germany: large replacement market; price-sensitive mid segment growing; buyers demand CE + energy labels and stable delivery.
UAE: hospitality construction boom drives HoReCa demand; re-export hub for wider GCC and East Africa.
Saudi Arabia: giga-projects create bulk project demand; local distribution partners are essential.
Netherlands: strong appliance import channel; sustainability arguments (energy class, repairability) matter.
UK: post-Brexit sourcing diversification favors non-EU suppliers with fast logistics.
sales_arguments: 25–35% landed-cost advantage vs Western European brands at comparable spec.
3-week delivery to EU main ports; 2 weeks to Jebel Ali.
OEM / white-label program with MOQ from 50 units.

messages.subject: Einbaugeräte mit CE-Zertifizierung — Partnerschaft mit Küchenprofi Handels GmbH
messages.body:
Guten Tag Anna Müller,

bei der Durchsicht des deutschen Fachhandels ist mir Küchenprofi Handels GmbH als etablierter Distributor in Frankfurt aufgefallen.

Silverine fertigt seit 2004 Einbaugeräte in Istanbul — CE- und TSE-zertifiziert, mit A+ Energieklassen. Unsere Partner in der EU erzielen 25–35% niedrigere Einkaufspreise gegenüber westeuropäischen Marken bei vergleichbarer Spezifikation, mit 3 Wochen Lieferzeit ab Werk.

Besonders interessant für Ihr Sortiment: unsere SVN-B Backofenserie (60cm, 9 Funktionen, Teleskopauszug) ab 50 Stück MOQ, auch als White-Label.

Hätten Sie kommende Woche 20 Minuten für ein kurzes Gespräch?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Meltem Aydın
Export Sales — Silverine

messages.subject: CE-certified professional kitchen equipment for Gulf Horeca Trading LLC projects
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I came across Gulf Horeca Trading LLC while researching hospitality suppliers in Abu Dhabi — your project portfolio stands out.

Silverine manufactures professional kitchen equipment in Istanbul: heavy-duty convection ovens, ranges and compact kitchen units, all CE and ISO 9001 certified. We currently deliver to Jebel Ali within two weeks, which our GCC partners use to win time-critical hotel fit-outs.

For projects like yours, our SVN-P HoReCa series offers a 20–30% landed-cost advantage against European brands, with a 24-month warranty backed by regional service partners.

Would you be open to a brief call this week? I can also send our GCC project reference list.

Best regards,
Meltem Aydın
Export Sales — Silverine
